Package org.example.simu.model

Class MyEngine

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Thread
org.example.simu.framework.Engine
org.example.simu.model.MyEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable, IEngine
public class MyEngine extends Engine
Main simulation engine implementation extending the discrete-event Engine framework.

Coordinates workstation service points, manages customer routing paths based on ordering channel types (dine-in, takeaway, online), processes discrete state transitions, controls execution flow (pause, resume, stop), and compiles final performance statistics for GUI visualization and database storage.

1.0
